name: Greek incremental
desc:
Welcome to Greek Incremental! An incremental game that is all about grinding currencies and getting better ones. 

Can you get on the leaderboard? 

- Earn points 
- Buy more features
- Earn even more points
- Reach new heights!

Good luck with your greek incremental adventure!
